title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 01-CONF does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve utilizar o método Anova, conforme descrito na 4ª edição do MSA, como método preferencial para enviar análises dos sistemas de medição à Cummins.
IT: "A VCM pode utilizar outros métodos de envio, desde que sejam aprovados pelo SQE via SCR."
Analysis: IT does not explicitly state 'ANOVA per MSA 4th edition' as the required method; only allows alternatives if approved.
action: Update IT to specify that ANOVA (MSA 4th edition) is the required method, with alternatives allowed only via SQE approval.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 01-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve utilizar o método Anova, conforme descrito na 4ª edição do MSA, como método preferencial para enviar análises dos sistemas de medição à Cummins.
IT: "O QM deve garantir que as análises dos sistemas de medição sejam enviadas regularmente, sem especificar o método a ser utilizado."
Analysis: specific mention of 'Anova conforme descrito na 4ª edição do MSA' as the preferred method
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that Anova (as described in the 4th edition of MSA) is the required method for submitting measurement system analyses to Cummins, ensuring alignment with the customer requirement.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 02-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve conceder 15 dias úteis adicionais ao fornecedor da Cummins para realizar a análise de subfornecedor após notificação.
IT: "O QM deve conceder um prazo adicional ao fornecedor da Cummins para realizar a análise de subfornecedor após notificação."
Analysis: specific duration (15 days úteis)
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that 'the QM must grant an additional 15 dias úteis ao fornecedor da Cummins para realizar a análise de subfornecedor após notificação' to fully satisfy the customer requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 00-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar a Cummins dentro de 15 dias úteis após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento.
IT: The IT allows up to 20 business days, while the requirement demands a strict 15-day limit. The IT’s deadline is longer than required, creating a conflict in the specific element of the deadline.
Analysis: The customer requirement mandates notification within 15 days, while the IT allows up to 20 days. Both address notifying Cummins after receiving a part requiring analysis, so 'same_activity' is confirmed. The IT's 20-day deadline is stricter than the requirement (shorter deadline), but since the requirement specifies a strict 15-day limit, the IT does not satisfy this specific element. A contradicting rule exists due to the differing deadlines. The IT’s wording ('maximum of 20 days') does not align with the customer's exact 15-day demand.
action: Update the IT to specify notification within 15 days úteis, aligning with the customer requirement. Ensure the revised IT explicitly states the 15-day deadline and confirms compliance with Cummins' JUDGE-SET p.1 section.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 00-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar a Cummins dentro de 15 dias úteis após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento.
IT: "O QM deve notificar a Cummins após receber uma peça que exige análise por parte da base de fornecimento."
Analysis: 15-day deadline for notification
action: Update IT 00-PART to explicitly state that the QM must notify Cummins **within 15 days úteis** of receiving a part requiring analysis by the supplier’s base.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 03-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode ser solicitado a cumprir os requisitos de qualidade do padrão ISO-3834 referentes a soldas, se pertencer a determinados segmentos da Cummins Inc.
IT: "O QM é responsável por monitorar os fornecedores..."
Analysis: explicit requirement to enforce ISO-3834 compliance
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that suppliers must comply with ISO-3834 welding requirements, including specific deadlines, standards, or approval processes as required by the customer.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 05-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve ser notificado pela Cummins sempre que houver uma não conformidade e alertado sobre a necessidade de ação corretiva
IT: The IT states: 'A VCM pode adiar a notificação ao fornecedor por até 72 horas após a identificação da não conformidade.' This allows a 72-hour delay, which directly contradicts the customer requirement for immediate notification upon non-conformity identification.
Analysis: The IT governs the same activity (notifying suppliers of non-conformities) as the customer requirement. However, the IT explicitly allows delaying notification by up to 72 hours after identifying a non-conformance, which directly contradicts the customer's explicit requirement for immediate notification upon occurrence of a non-conformity. The IT’s rule permits a delay, whereas the requirement mandates no delay.
action: Revise IT TEST 05-CONF to remove the 72-hour delay rule and ensure notification occurs immediately upon identification of a non-conformity, aligning with the customer's requirement for real-time supplier notification.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 06-CONF does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve designar um interlocutor de qualidade, que será o principal canal de comunicação dos requisitos do Manual para a sua organização.
IT: "A VCM pode indicar qualquer pessoa como interlocutor de qualidade."
Analysis: Specific role definition for 'interlocutor de qualidade' (e.g., responsibilities, qualifications, or formal appointment criteria to ensure it is a dedicated quality liaison role)
action: Update the IT to explicitly define the 'interlocutor de qualidade' as a dedicated role with clear responsibilities for communicating Manual requirements. Ensure the IT specifies that this person must be formally appointed and have authority to act on behalf of LEONI regarding quality-related communications.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 04-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar todas as peças devolvidas e relatar os resultados da análise à Cummins conforme definido na Tabela 1a.
IT: "O QM deve garantir que todas as peças devolvidas sejam analisadas e os resultados relatados à Cummins."
Analysis: reference to Table 1a in IT
action: Update IT to explicitly mention reporting per Table 1a as required by the customer

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 04-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar todas as peças devolvidas e relatar os resultados da análise à Cummins conforme definido na Tabela 1a.
IT: A VCM pode optar por não analisar algumas peças devolvidas, desde que o relatório seja feito apenas para as peças consideradas críticas
Analysis: Mandatory analysis of all returned parts (no exceptions allowed)
action: Revise the IT to remove the exception for non-critical parts and explicitly require full analysis of **all** returned pieces, aligning with the customer’s 'ALL' requirement. Ensure the IT prohibits skipping any analysis unless explicitly stated in the customer’s Tabela 1a.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 07-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve receber peças para análise de reclamações de garantia enviadas à Cummins a uma taxa de 30% do volume total de falhas em campo, em média, ao longo de cada período de um ano.
IT: The QM may determine a return rate lower than 30% of the total field failure volume if technical justification exists. This allows rates below 30%, conflicting with the customer's exact 30% requirement.
Analysis: The customer requirement mandates a **specific 30% return rate** for parts to analyze warranty claims. The IT allows QM to set a **lower rate than 30%** if justified, which directly contradicts the requirement's exact numerical threshold. While both address 'return rates for warranty analysis', the IT’s flexibility (allowing <30%) conflicts with the customer’s strict 30% mandate. The IT does not enforce the 30% rate as a fixed rule but permits deviations under technical justification, violating the requirement’s specificity.
action: Revise IT 07-CONF to **enforce a fixed 30% return rate** as per the customer requirement. Remove or amend the rule allowing QM to set rates below 30%, ensuring compliance with the specific numerical threshold in the customer’s warranty claim analysis process.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 07-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve receber peças para análise de reclamações de garantia enviadas à Cummins a uma taxa de 30% do volume total de falhas em campo, em média, ao longo de cada período de um ano.
IT: "O QM deve determinar o volume de peças a serem devolvidas ao fornecedor com base em critérios técnicos"
Analysis: Specific '30% of field failures' criterion
action: Update IT 07-PART to explicitly state that the return rate must be **30% of field failures** annually, aligning with the customer requirement. Ensure this value is included in both the QM's technical criteria and VCM's calculation process.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 11-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar Cummins sobre qualquer alteração na estrutura da gestão, dentro de duas semanas após sua implementação.
IT: A VCM must notify Cummins within four weeks after the implementation of changes in the management structure.
Analysis: Specific deadline of two weeks as required by the customer
action: Update the IT to specify a 2-week deadline for notifying Cummins about changes in management structure, aligning with the customer's requirement.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 11-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar Cummins sobre qualquer alteração na estrutura da gestão, dentro de duas semanas após sua implementação.
IT: "O QM é responsável por acompanhar qualquer alteração feita na estrutura da gestão, garantindo que seja comunicada à Cummins em tempo hábil."
Analysis: specific 2-week deadline for notification
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that the Quality Manager must notify Cummins **within two weeks** of implementing any changes to the management structure, replacing the generic 'em tempo hábil' phrasing.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 08-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: The IT allows analysis within 7 business days (longer than the customer's requirement of 5 days) and does not mandate clear identification of critical returns, which directly contradicts the customer's explicit requirements.
Analysis: Clear identification of critical returns as per the customer's requirement
action: Update the IT to align with the customer's deadline of 5 business days for critical failure analysis and explicitly require clear identification of such returns. Ensure all rules in the IT strictly adhere to the customer's specified deadlines and mandatory identification criteria.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 08-COMP does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: "O resultado da análise deve ser comunicado ao cliente em até 5 dias úteis após a identificação"
Analysis: explicit mandate for 'clearly identified' returns (e.g., labeling, documentation, or communication of critical failure status)
action: Update the IT to explicitly require that critical failed parts are clearly marked/identified in all relevant records and communications (e.g., through labels, system flags, or documented classification). Ensure this is integrated into both analysis procedures and customer reporting processes.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 08-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica em até 5 dias úteis, sendo que essas devoluções são identificadas claramente.
IT: "O QM deve analisar peças com falha classificadas como crítica dentro de um prazo razoável"
Analysis: Specific 5-day deadline for critical failure analysis
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that critical failed parts must be analyzed within 5 business days, aligning with the customer requirement. Ensure the IT includes a clear definition of 'reasonable timeframe' as 5 days and specifies the method for tracking compliance (e.g., system alerts, deadlines).

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 10-CONF
detail:
Requirement: Todas as propostas de alteração no design da embalagem para produtos existentes exigem que o fornecedor reenvie uma Planilha de Dados de Embalagem (PDS) ao gerente de sourcing da Cummins para fins de revisão e aprovação interna.
IT: "A VCM não é obrigada a reenviar o PDS ao gerente de sourcing da Cummins."
Analysis: IT explicitly states no obligation for some suppliers (VCM) to resend PDS; contradicts customer requirement applying to all existing products.
action: Revise IT: Remove exclusion clause ensuring ALL suppliers must resend PDS.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 12-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode utilizar o ISIR, relatório de dimensão e documentos de materiais/desempenho para registrar as declarações de conformidade com os padrões da Cummins durante o PPAP.
IT: The IT states: 'QM may use formats other than ISIR, dimension report, and material/performance documents' (explicitly allowing alternatives), which contradicts the requirement mandating **specific** documents (ISIR + materials/performance).
Analysis: The IT allows QM to use formats other than ISIR, dimension report, and material/performance documents (contradicting the requirement that mandates these specific documents). The VCM rule restricts to dimension/report and performance documents but excludes ISIR. The customer requires **specific** documents (ISIR + materials/performance), while the IT permits alternatives, creating a direct conflict. The same_activity is confirmed as both address PPAP conformity declaration registration by QM/PR.
action: Revise IT 12-CONF to explicitly restrict QM/PR from using alternative formats for PPAP conformity declarations, ensuring compliance with Cummins' requirement to use ISIR, dimension report, and material/performance documents.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 12-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor pode utilizar o ISIR, relatório de dimensão e documentos de materiais/desempenho para registrar as declarações de conformidade com os padrões da Cummins durante o PPAP.
IT: "O QM deve registar as declarações de conformidade no PPAP."
Analysis: ISIR, dimension report, material/performance documents
action: Update the IT to explicitly include the required document types (ISIR, dimension report, material/performance documents) in the registration process for PPAP conformity declarations.

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 13-COMP does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: "O prazo máximo para notificação é de 2 horas após a identificação do risco."
Analysis: no defined timeframe for immediate notification
action: Update the IT to remove the 2-hour deadline and explicitly state that notifications must occur 'immediately' without time constraints, aligning with the customer's requirement.

title: [simulated IT] Conflict: JUDGE-SET p.1 vs TEST 13-CONF
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: The IT permits a 24-hour delay with purchasing director authorization, which contradicts the requirement for **immediate** notification. The time frame and conditional approval process do not align with the customer’s expectation of real-time risk communication.
Analysis: The customer requirement mandates **immediate** notification of risks affecting Cummins' deliveries/services. The IT allows a **maximum of 24 hours** with prior authorization, which directly contradicts the requirement's emphasis on immediacy. While the IT covers the same activity (notifying Cummins about risks), it does not satisfy the specific element of 'immediate' notification. The IT’s 24-hour deadline and authorization delay mechanism violate the customer’s explicit demand for real-time communication.
action: Update the IT to remove the 24-hour deadline and authorization condition, ensuring all risks affecting Cummins' deliveries/services trigger **immediate** notification to the sourcing manager or SQE without delays. Add a specific rule stating 'Notification must occur within 0 hours (i.e., immediately) upon risk identification, with no conditional delays.'

title: [simulated IT] IT TEST 13-PART does not fully cover a requirement of JUDGE-SET p.1
detail:
Requirement: O fornecedor deve notificar imediatamente o gerente de sourcing ou o SQE da Cummins em caso de riscos que possam afetar as entregas ou serviços
IT: "A notificação deve ser feita com clareza e em tempo hábil, sem especificação de prazo ou destinatários definidos."
Analysis: named recipients (Sourcing Manager/SQE) and specific deadline (immediate)
action: Update the IT to explicitly state that risks must be notified **immediately** to **Cummins' Sourcing Manager/SQE**, aligning with the customer requirement’s specifics.
